## Reviews
- Code, security and simplification self-reviews completed and recorded with `reggie check`; findings and corrections are in .reggie/tasks/client-data-flow/evidence/review.md.

## Deviations from plan
- Browser verification showed the full chat graph made client labels unreadable. Added a compact Request path default with a Full server flow switch, preserving every server story card and existing caps. Compact maps use vertical dagre spacing and a taller tablet frame.
- Retained primary navigation as a bottom bar on tablets as well as phones instead of preserving the old hidden-navigation breakpoint.

## Discovered issues
- None.

## Open risks
- React state/prop handoffs, dynamic callback dispatch and non-JSX event registration remain unproven. The UI states these limits and does not invent a suggested-message click.
- Existing server breadth caps still omit 17 steps in the real chat flow and remain explicitly reported.
- Portable doctor reports three existing native-layout warnings; this packet, file notes and evidence are the durable handoff rather than adding a parallel documentation system.
